_comment: AI b-roll for the promo's 'old way' opening. Still: Z-Image-Turbo. Motion: LTX-2.3 (Wan 2.2 as backup). The screen content is NOT generated here; it's an HTML capture cut in separately. Same wardrobe text in every people shot keeps the lecturer consistent.
style: cinematic film still, shallow depth of field, late night, dim room lit by a warm desk lamp and cool laptop glow, muted teal and warm amber tones, 35mm film grain, photorealistic, no text, no logos, no watermark
negative: text, subtitles, logo, watermark, readable screen, user interface, oversaturated, cartoon, deformed hands, deformed face, extra fingers, fast motion, jump cut, static frame

shots.image: Wide shot of a small cluttered university lecturer's office at night, a single warm desk lamp, an open laptop glowing on the desk, stacks of journal papers and folders, bookshelves, a window showing dark night sky with distant city lights, an empty office chair pulled up to the desk, no people
shots.motion: very slow push-in toward the desk, the laptop screen glow flickers softly, still and quiet mood

shots.image: Over-the-shoulder view from behind of exactly one Malaysian woman lecturer in her forties wearing a dusty-rose hijab and a navy cardigan, sitting at a desk facing an open laptop late at night, the laptop screen is a soft out-of-focus bright glow, her right hand on a computer mouse, desk lamp, papers on the desk, seen from behind so her face is not visible
shots.motion: slow steady push-in toward the glowing laptop screen over her shoulder, she stays still

shots.image: Extreme close-up of one woman's right hand resting on a black computer mouse on a wooden desk late at night, navy cardigan sleeve, fingertip on the left button, lit by cool laptop glow and a warm desk lamp, a cup of coffee blurred in the background
shots.motion: the hand nudges the mouse very slightly to the right, a tiny careful movement, then freezes

shots.image: Side view medium shot of exactly one Malaysian woman lecturer in her forties wearing a dusty-rose hijab and a navy cardigan, sitting at a desk in front of an open laptop late at night, leaning back in her office chair with both hands covering her face in frustration, desk lamp, stacks of papers, the laptop screen is a soft out-of-focus glow
shots.motion: she slowly slumps back further in the chair, hands still over her face, shoulders drop with a sigh, slow gentle push-in

shots.image: Close-up of a half-empty mug of cold coffee on a wooden desk beside a laptop late at night, an analogue desk clock behind it showing a little after two o'clock, warm desk lamp light, shallow depth of field
shots.motion: very slow rack focus from the coffee mug to the clock, nothing else moves

shots._note: Retake of o4 motion from the same still: v1 dropped her hands, changed her expression to a smile and changed the cardigan.
shots.motion: she keeps both hands over her face the whole time, only her shoulders rise and fall slowly with one tired sigh, very slow push-in, nothing else changes

shots._note: Retake of o5 from the same still: v1's rack focus redrew the clock face.
shots.motion: very slow push-in toward the coffee mug, focus stays on the mug, the clock stays soft and unchanged in the background

shots._note: v2 opening (male lecturer, design C). Still generated by Codex imagegen from promo/design/variant-C.png.
shots.motion: slow steady push-in over his shoulder toward the glowing laptop screen, he stays still with his hand on the mouse, the city lights twinkle softly outside

shots._note: v2 opening (male lecturer, design C). Still generated by Codex imagegen from promo/design/variant-C.png.
shots.motion: he keeps both palms pressed over his face the whole time and slowly sinks back into the chair with one tired sigh, shoulders drop, very slow push-in, nothing else changes

shots._note: Ad bookend: same office, computer works on its own. Still by Codex imagegen (promo/design/shot-bookend.png).
shots.motion: locked-off static camera, no camera movement. he stays leaning back with both hands clasped behind his head, breathing slowly and calmly, relaxed; a thin wisp of steam rises from the mug; the city lights twinkle softly outside; the laptop and its screen stay perfectly still
